stories.title: The Pope on AI art: "an ontological difference"
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV posted that "in this era of artificial intelligence, it is becoming urgent to distinguish human art from what machines produce," saying there is "an ontological difference, even before an aesthetic one" between art and what a machine generates from millions of other people's images. It got 460K likes, the most of any post that day, and turned into a day-long argument about AI art. The Latin version on his @Pontifex_ln account inspired "The pope is calling your AI art shit in Latin" (50K).
